content.short: Lighter is a perpetuals DEX using custom ZK circuits for verifiable matching and liquidations.
content.description: Lighter runs perpetual futures on an Ethereum L2 built around custom zero-knowledge circuits, so that order matching and liquidations can be proven correct rather than taken on trust. That is a meaningful distinction for a derivatives venue, where the operator has both the opportunity and the incentive to misbehave at exactly the moments that matter most to users. Robinhood's chain documentation lists a Lighter deployment among the perpetuals venues on Robinhood Chain.
